 Who Is Cooper Pratt Wife? Meet His Girlfriend Jansyn Hollis in 2026
 By 
 ashutoshkumarashu5555@gmail.com 
 / 28.10.2026 
 Post Updated: Wednesday, October 28, 2026 
 Cooper Pratt has captured attention as a standout rookie shortstop for the Milwaukee Brewers during their 2026 World Series run. At just 22 years old, the athletic infielder signed a massive eight-year extension before even making his major-league debut. Naturally, fans are curious about his personal life—especially whether he has a wife. The short answer is no. Cooper Pratt is not married. He is in a committed relationship with his longtime girlfriend, Jansyn Hollis.
 Here’s a clear, up-to-date look at the young couple supporting each other through an unforgettable season.

 Cooper Pratt and Jansyn Hollis: Their Relationship Timeline
 Pratt and Hollis have been dating since at least mid-2025, well before his rapid rise through the Brewers’ system. She was by his side when he made his MLB debut in June 2026. After that first game, Hollis shared photos on social media expressing pride and gratitude for her boyfriend, tagging him with heartfelt messages. Their relationship has remained steady and relatively private as Pratt’s professional profile exploded during the postseason.
 Both share strong ties to the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, which forms a core part of their values and daily lives.
 Who Is Jansyn Hollis?
 Jansyn Hollis grew up in Mississippi and attended Parklane Academy in McComb, a private K-12 school. She graduated in May 2023 and was a member of the school’s varsity cheerleading team. After high school she completed an 18-month religious mission for the LDS Church that took her to locations in the Caribbean. She returned home around mid-2025, which lines up with the start of her public relationship with Pratt.
 Hollis comes from a larger family—she has two brothers and four sisters. Like Pratt, she is a devout member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Friends and observers describe the couple as grounded, faith-centered, and supportive of each other’s goals.

 How Their Shared Values Shape Their Story
 Several elements stand out in how the couple approaches life together:
 Strong emphasis on faith and personal standards consistent with LDS teachings
 Mutual support during high-pressure moments, such as Pratt’s debut and playoff games
 Preference for keeping most private details offline while celebrating big milestones publicly
 Roots in Mississippi communities that value family, hard work, and community involvement
 Pratt’s own family background reinforces this foundation. His parents, Russell and Heidi Pratt, raised him in the Oxford, Mississippi area with deep Utah and LDS connections. His father serves as a local church bishop and helped build a baseball training facility known as “The Farm.” That environment of discipline, faith, and athletic focus clearly influences how Cooper approaches both baseball and relationships.
 Conclusion
 As of late October 2026, Cooper Pratt does not have a wife. He is happily dating Jansyn Hollis, a supportive partner who shares his faith and has been present through every major step of his young major-league career. Their relationship reflects quiet confidence, shared values, and genuine encouragement—qualities that resonate with fans watching the Brewers compete on baseball’s biggest stage. While the spotlight stays mostly on Pratt’s glove and bat, the steady presence of Hollis offers a glimpse into the personal foundation supporting one of the game’s rising stars.
